summary: SIP Irrigation Control is an open-source application designed to manage sprinkler and irrigation systems. It provides a web-based interface for scheduling and operating watering zones on your property. The software is written in Python and licensed under the GPL-3.0.
goodFor: It suits technical users who want to self-host their sprinkler automation using existing hardware rather than relying on proprietary cloud services.
watchOut: The project shows low activity and infrequent tagged releases, meaning you may need to patch bugs yourself or deal with outdated dependencies.
deployNotes: As a Python application, you will typically need to configure a WSGI server, set up a reverse proxy for TLS termination, and ensure persistent storage for your schedule configurations.
